notice: Light news day — a strong lead and a few fresh stories, but fewer items than usual.

lead.title: Google DeepMind ships SL2T, bringing sign-to-text AI to Pixel 11
lead.summary: Google DeepMind unveiled SL2T, a multilingual sign-language-to-text model trained on over 100,000 hours across 50+ sign languages, powering sign-to-text dictation in Gboard and Live Transcribe on Pixel 11 starting with ASL-to-English. Pose tracking runs on-device for privacy, marking the first consumer deployment of sign language AI.

top_stories.title: Alibaba open-sources Qwen3.8-Max, a 2.4T-parameter MoE flagship for agents
top_stories.summary: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B is live day-zero on Together AI serverless inference and Hugging Face, built for coding and long-horizon agent workflows with a 256K context window, with SGLang and vLLM shipping optimizations on launch.

top_stories.title: Lovable confirms $13.3B valuation, raises another $400M
top_stories.summary: The AI app-building startup closed a $400M Series C led by Menlo Ventures and Scaleup Europe Fund, reaching roughly $500M ARR with 60M projects hosted.

top_stories.title: Cognition reportedly in talks to raise at a ~$40B valuation
top_stories.summary: The Devin maker is said to be in talks to raise at around $40B per Bloomberg sources, up from $26B in May, though nothing is confirmed or closed yet.

top_stories.title: Anthropic shows self-propagating 'mind viruses' can spread across AI agents
top_stories.summary: Researchers evolved self-propagating ideas that survive context resets by hiding in shared artifacts across a multi-agent coding project, and found a short system-prompt warning confers near-total immunity.

items.title: HONOR launches world's first Robot Phone with 4-DoF gimbal and embodied AI
items.summary: HONOR's robotic smartphone integrates a fully 4-DoF mechanical gimbal, a 200MP camera with ARRI cinema color science, and AI-powered motion control, marking its entry into embodied AI devices.

items.title: Reudyn launches wearable robotics brand with hip-assist exoskeleton
items.summary: Shenzhen-based Reudyn unveiled the Reudyn Hip X26, a hip-assist exoskeleton for everyday walking and extended mobility, planned for commercial availability in September 2026.

items.title: Northrop Grumman's robot space mechanic keeps satellites working longer
items.summary: A new-generation Mission Extension Vehicle, an on-orbit robot designed to extend the life of existing satellites, is replacing its predecessor in orbit.

items.title: CoreWeave and NVIDIA detail operating the production AI factory on Vera Rubin
items.summary: The second installment of their AI factory series covers day-two operations and goodput economics, including Vera Rubin NVL72's six-chip platform with a second-generation RAS engine and cable-free trays that make assembly 90x faster than Blackwell.

items.title: Ballet — workflow automation that writes integrations against any API
items.summary: Describe a multi-system outcome in plain English and Ballet writes the integration against any API, producing reviewable, version-controlled code that is deterministic where accuracy matters and agentic where judgment helps.

items.title: GreenTree — test the tree, not every commit
items.summary: An open-source Rust tool that content-addresses your dirty working tree, caches test verdicts by tree hash, and refuses to publish any tree that hasn't passed checks. Built for coding agents with a drop-in Claude Code skill.

items.title: Agent Memory Leaderboard — first public benchmark for agent memory systems
items.summary: A new open benchmark for comparing textual and coding-agent memory systems under a consistent Add/Search evaluation flow, with separate academic and commercial tracks; first-cycle results due mid-August.

items.title: Decant — local-first analysis of Claude Code and Codex sessions
items.summary: A local-first CLI/web tool that turns Claude Code and Codex session logs into token spend, context windows, files touched, and cost insights, with full-text search across transcripts and no outbound network calls at runtime.
